title: Skeptics Called Colored Numbers Fake Poetry, Yet Synesthetes Crushed a One-Second Camouflage Test
description:
You think everyone sees printed numbers in plain black! Yet millions automatically see crisp colors on blank pages! This is the true story of Ramachandran's Synesthesia Pop-Out Test. Here is what went wrong with a century of doubt.
